subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “But one afternoon, an old woman came alone and could not open her ticket.”?
options: Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
She had bought it with help from her grandson, but he was not with her.
He did not want to tell anyone, so he sat quietly while others bought food.
She explained that the dog had followed her grandson to school once and remembered the place.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「But one afternoon, an old woman came alone and could not open her ticket. She had bought it with help from her grandson, but…」，答案為「She had bought it with help from her grandson, but he was not with her.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「She had bought it with help from her grandson, but he was not with her.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
